use_case_summary: Briarwood is an SMB SaaS for small-to-mid e-commerce merchants. They signed up self-serve for Redwood Hosted API to add an in-product chat assistant and semantic doc search. Primary requirements: p95 chat latency <600ms, 15-30 req/s, tight cost constraints. Security/legal need early artifacts: SOC2 (or SOC2 summary), full sub-processor list, and a DPA template to start procurement. Deployment will remain public cloud (us-west-2) for now; may request EU handling for a subset of customers later.
